+        return 403, {"error": "forbidden"}
+

+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}

+import pytest
+import os
+from app.api.handlers import handle_delete_user
+from app.db import store
+
+# Set the admin token for testing
+os.environ["ADMIN_TOKEN"] = "secret123"
+
+def test_handle_delete_user_success():
+    # Setup: ensure user 1 exists
+    assert store.get_by_id(1) is not None
+    
+    params = {"id": "1", "token": "secret123"}
+    status, response = handle_delete_user(params)
+    assert status == 200
+    assert response == {"deleted": "1"}
+    
+    # Verify it is deleted
+    assert store.get_by_id(1) is None
+
+def test_handle_delete_user_no_token():
+    params = {"id": "1"}
+    status, response = handle_delete_user(params)
+    assert status == 403
+    assert response == {"error": "forbidden"}
+
+def test_handle_delete_user_wrong_token():
+    params = {"id": "1", "token": "wrong"}
+    status, response = handle_delete_user(params)
+    assert status == 403
+    assert response == {"error": "forbidden"}
+
+def test_handle_delete_user_invalid_id():
+    params = {"id": "abc", "token": "secret123"}
+    status, response = handle_delete_user(params)
+    assert status == 400
+    assert response == {"error": "invalid id"}
+
+def test_handle_delete_user_not_found():
+    # User 999 should not exist
+    params = {"id": "999", "token": "secret123"}
+    status, response = handle_delete_user(params)
+    assert status == 404
+    assert response == {"error": "not found"}
+
+def test_handle_delete_user_no_admin_token_configured():

+        params = {"id": "1", "token": "any"}
+        status, response = handle_delete_user(params)
+        assert status == 403
+        assert response == {"error": "forbidden"}
+    finally:
+        os.environ["ADMIN_TOKEN"] = original_token
